data:
Decision: NO-GO. Win probability 1.9%.

Top drivers of low probability (SHAP): (1) Low expected evaluation score (45.2) is the dominant negative—proposal as currently positioned will likely be non-competitive on technical/quality scoring. (2) Five compliance gaps and only 57.1% compliance coverage materially undermine responsiveness and risk disqualification. (3) Limited time to respond (240 hrs) slightly reduces the ability to close gaps and strengthen technical narrative; positives (large budget fit, compliance coverage) are marginal.

Mandatory gaps and what it takes to close: (1) PEC registration C‑B+ with relevant electrical/civil codes: obtain/upgrade registration (or bid via qualified JV/consortium lead). (2) ISO 14001 covering civil construction: certification via accredited body; fastest via partnering with certified contractor. (3) Avg turnover ≥ PKR 2,500M (3 years): require audited accounts meeting threshold or JV with qualifying entity. (4) Prime contractor reference ≥ PKR 1,500M safe-city/surveillance: need eligible past project or JV with prime. (5) Trenching/boring/pole plant within 50 km Islamabad: lease/commitment letters from suppliers or local subcontractor with owned plant.

Recommendation: No-go unless a compliant JV can be formed immediately to cover all five mandatory gaps and lift the technical score.
